entries.title: Merge duplicate customers
entries.description: Review linked quotes and units, then merge duplicate customers while preserving quotes, unit ownership history and missing contact details. The duplicate customer is permanently removed.

entries.title: Check for duplicate customers before saving
entries.description: When adding a customer or creating a quote, review matching names and choose an existing customer or confirm a different company. The Assistant also checks for possible duplicates.

entries.title: Choose an existing customer when creating a quote
entries.description: Creating a quote with a new customer now warns you about matching names. Review the matches, use an existing customer, or confirm that this is a different company.
